items.zh: 美国宇航局一代人以来首次金星任务的情况终于有了好转

items.title: Chronic back pain may activate an unexpected brain network, study finds
items.summary: Movement-induced flares in chronic back pain activate brain regions involved in self-reflection, suggesting chronic pain may be processed differently than acute pain.
items.zh: 研究发现慢性背痛可能会激活意想不到的大脑网络

items.title: Researchers use AI to design proteins that cut up other proteins
items.summary: AI design tools make proteins that break bonds that are stable for hundreds of years.
items.zh: 研究人员利用人工智能设计能够切割其他蛋白质的蛋白质

items.title: Can math stay human in the age of AI?
items.summary: As AI churns out mathematical proofs, a DeepMind study raises a bigger question: What do we lose when we focus only on the answers?
items.zh: 人工智能时代，数学还能保持人性吗？

items.title: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
items.summary: A new machine-learning approach broke records for weather forecasting for an important time frame in emergency planning.
items.zh: 研究人员预计两到六周后会改进天气预报

items.title: Tiny implants can use the body itself to talk to each other
items.summary: Researchers made a rat’s front-leg movement trigger its back leg. The experiment could point to a new kind of body-based network to connect implants.
items.zh: 微型植入物可以利用身体本身来相互交谈
